messages:
naveen (partnerships): FYI we have a new hardware SI: EdgeCore wants to list their gateway in the cloud marketplace. They've asked what evidence format we need and whether firmware should be sent in the same bundle.

lio (security): Important: firmware blobs = special handling. We require firmware hash attestations + chain-of-custody notes. If they upload firmware, it must be encrypted at rest and accessible only to pen vendor + our redaction team.

hannah (solutions): From infra side we can spin a customer-scoped bucket and a short-term KMS-encrypted prefix. Suggest: /edgecore-1760012345/raw and /edgecore-1760012345/attestations. Which one does pen vendor need?

tara (compliance): Marketplace checklist: SOC2 Type II report (PDF), penetration test (scoped with signed statement of work), firmware attestation (sha256 + signer cert), network topologies (annotated), data-flow diagrams, and the completed vendor questionnaire. Prefer structured manifest.json in root.

naveen (partnerships): POC is a.choi@edgecore-hw.com; they're targeting a listing freeze for May 2. Pen test window proposed Apr 18-22, with a witness day Apr 20. Can we meet those dates?

lio (security): We can do witness Apr 20 if pen vendor confirms timezone. NDA must be signed before any presign. Also: redaction policy will strip customer-identifiable logs and internal hostnames. We'll produce a redaction report after the pass.

hannah (solutions): I'll create the bucket and attach an IAM role limited to PutObject/GetObject and List (no Delete). We'll set a KMS key policy that denies Decrypt except for the pen vendor and our redaction principal. Example presign command we give partners:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/edgecore-1760012345/raw/edgecore_bundle.zip --expires-in 86400
```

naveen (partnerships): For the manifest, Tara, can you paste the required keys so EdgeCore can populate them?

tara (compliance): Manifest fields we require (JSON keys): vendor_name, contact_email, artifact_types (list), sha256_checksums (object mapping filename->sha256), scope_start, scope_end, nda_signed (boolean), firmware_signer (if present), firmware_cert_chain (path), attestation_statements (list), third_party_pen_vendor (name + contact).

lio (security): Add: redaction_exemptions (list) if they have approved tokens/logs we can keep. Also we need the pen vendor SOW and vendor contact for scheduling.

vault-bot: kms-key-created arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-gh23-ijkl (restricted)

hannah (solutions): Bucket created: s3://marketplace-evidence/edgecore-1760012345. IAM role edgecore-uploader-176001 created. I'll DM the role ARN to a.choi once NDA is in place.

naveen (partnerships): I'll send the NDA link and intro to a.choi now. Also notifying product for the announcement cadence.

lio (security): After upload I'll run an initial check for obvious PII and report findings. Pen vendor will need an S3 presign for each artifact; we prefer one artifact per presign for audit clarity.

hannah (solutions): Presign TTL we agreed on: 24h for pen vendor, 72h for vendor upload. We'll log every presign in the audit log. Example per-file presign:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/edgecore-1760012345/raw/firmware_v1.bin --expires-in 86400
```

naveen (partnerships): Perfect. EdgeCore asked if we accept a separate HSM attestation package instead of firmware in the ZIP. Tara: is that allowed?

tara (compliance): Yes, allowed. If they provide HSM attestation, we need the attestation artifact plus signer certs and the procedure doc showing key custody. Make sure manifest references the attestation path.

lio (security): One more: any reported CVEs from the pen test must be triaged within our SLA window. We'll need an action owner (pick someone from EdgeCore) and a timeline commitment in the SOW.

naveen (partnerships): I'll ask them to add a remediation owner field in the manifest and confirm SLA. I'll update thread when NDA is signed and I've introduced them. :handshake:

hannah (solutions): Added lifecycle tag: marketplace:pending-edgecore-1760012345. I'll also add retention policy 180 days for raw uploads in case we need re-review.

vault-bot: presign-log entry created for 1 pending presigns (will populate once NDA accepted)

lio (security): Thanks all — once NDA and bucket/policy are live I'll coordinate the witness schedule with the pen vendor and post the calendar invite.

naveen (partnerships): Closing loop for now. Will follow up with calendar + intro. :calendar:
